# Scheduler decisions recorded from 9d9b228f (the deployed base of plan 3.1 stage 3).
#
# Recorded by copying tests/equivalence.rs unchanged into a 9d9b228f worktree and running
#   SCHEDULER_EQUIVALENCE_RECORD=<dir> cargo test -p services --lib scheduler_equivalence
# there: every line below is what the scanning dispatcher did with real rows. Two
# recordings from the same binary were byte-identical. Sections, in order: steady
# (dispatcher already running), startup (first pass), review, load, wake.
#
# A line `key: outcome` is the base outcome for that Task. A line starting with
# `@<Exception> ` replaces the outcome for its key; only the three changes the
# stage allows may be named:
#   ExplicitOwnerPark   a Task the base left with no step, owner or annotation
#                       now carries a visible annotation naming its owner action
#   MissedWakeRepair    work the base only re-drove at startup is re-driven on
#                       an ordinary pass
#   IdleTickQuiescence  the dispatcher does no work on an idle tick; no recorded
#                       outcome differs, so no line names it
